verdict.rationale: Marketing pages list 'Apple Watch — Improved convenience and accessibility' as a feature, implying smartwatch code viewing, but there's no detail on how codes are read on the watch (e.g., independent watch app, complication, or requiring phone proximity) and no hands-on/community corroboration of the experience. missing for 10: technical details of the watch app/complication, independent or user confirmation that codes can be read without the phone nearby, Android Wear/Wear OS support info.
